resources.string: Recording the trace. Pause or finish from this notification.
Context or access changed. Reopen the trace from the authorised map.
Allow precise location to start or resume the trace.
Capture interrupted. You can explicitly resume the retained draft.
Draft recovered, capture stopped. Resume creates a new portion.
Draft write not confirmed. Capture stopped; retry before leaving.
Save needs confirmation. Retry the same save; its identity is retained.
Check name and trace: names are limited to 120 characters without control characters, and at least one portion needs two points.
At least one portion with two points is required to save a trace.
No other trace stored in this context.
Technical settings for this capture, retained with the trace. Old, imprecise or simulated fixes are excluded. They certify neither trace accuracy nor completeness.
GeoJSON · %1$d portions · %2$d points\nIncludes recorded coordinates and accuracies. Unrecorded passages remain separate.
Sharing could not be prepared. The trace is retained.

Source: phone positions. WGS84 coordinates, EPSG:4326. Horizontal length on the IUGG mean sphere of radius 6,371,008.8 m, computed within each portion; no links between portions, closing segment, slope or altitude added.
Method: %1$s, version 1.
Trace accuracy: not determined. Fix accuracies are not overall uncertainty.
Reported threshold: %2$s m; maximum fix age %3$d s; minimum spacing %4$s m; observation gap after %5$d s. Duration excludes stopped review and process downtime.

Manual pause: no points until Resume. Missing or insufficient quality suspends additions; a usable fix starts a new portion. Finish stops sensors and opens draft review. Process interruption never restarts capture automatically.
Last position is out of date
Copy of a saved trace; the original is retained.
